versions.changelog:
Initial release: Build and deploy autonomous gambling bots for Telegram, Discord, and Twitter.

- Provides bot templates for Telegram (python-telegram-bot), Discord (Discord.js), and Twitter API integrations.
- Supports provably fair crypto betting via Agent Casino API with automated betting, slash commands, and bot notifications.
- Features include coinflip, dice, balance/history tracking, auto-play mode, and referral tracking.
- Real-time notifications, inline keyboards, and tweet-based results for interactive user experience.
- Includes quick setup scripts and documentation for fast deployment.
